What was supposed to be a standard travel day turned into an absolute test of patience! In this video, I take you through my exhausting journey crossing the border from Peru into Bolivia. I ended up stuck in a massive, chaotic line for 7 straight hours just to get my passport stamped.
If you are planning to travel between Peru and Bolivia, you should know that there are two very different ways to cross the border:
The Border Crossings Explained
